name: MeshRenderer
doc: Draws geometry at the entity's interpolated world transform.

fields.name: shape
fields.doc: Procedural shape, drawn when model is empty.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Shape size: box extents, sphere/capsule diameter in x and capsule height in y, plane extents in x and z.

fields.name: model
fields.doc: Imported model (@path#id of a glTF/FBX source). Its meshes are drawn instead of the shape; skinned meshes follow this entity's Animator.

fields.name: node
fields.doc: Source node name or numeric glTF index. name:3 selects a numeric name. The drawable subtree retains source rotation/scale and restores its pivot to the entity origin. Absent selects the complete default scene.

fields.name: primitive
fields.doc: Zero-based primitive within the selected subtree (or whole model).

fields.name: materialOverrides
fields.doc: Native material assets by subtree-local primitive slot; omitted slots use the model.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Linear base color multiplier and opacity.

fields.name: emissive
fields.doc: Default procedural radiance, or an RGB emission multiplier with a model/material asset. Models treat zero RGB as neutral; use emissiveEnabled to switch them off.

fields.name: emissiveEnabled
fields.doc: Enables emission without modifying the source model or its materials.

fields.name: emissiveStrength
fields.doc: Emission multiplier, applied once after the source or overridden factor.

fields.name: emissiveFactor
fields.doc: Optional linear RGB replacement for the source emissive factor, useful for lamps.

fields.name: emissiveMaterials
fields.doc: Source material names or numeric indices affected by emissiveFactor. Empty targets all; name:3 disambiguates a numeric material name.

usage.label: Add it
usage.html: ara do component.add -p entity=name:Crate -p component=MeshRenderer --why "Add MeshRenderer"

usage.label: Set a field
usage.html: ara do property.set -p entity=name:Crate -p path=MeshRenderer.shape -p value="box" --why "Tune MeshRenderer"

usage.label: In a scene document
usage.html:
{
  "MeshRenderer": {
    "shape": "box"
  }
}

usage.label: From C#
usage.html:
/// <summary>Brighten a model lamp without replacing its material.</summary>
public static void UseMeshRenderer(Entity entity, in Tick tick)
{
    ref var component = ref World.Get<MeshRenderer>(entity);
    component.EmissiveStrength = 2f;
}
